notes: Tyler New World is the dominant CAD system in Texas municipalities. No national standard exists. Fields match Tyler export format used by CCPD/CCFD/CCEMS.

entity_catalog.units_and_stations: registries/cad_units.json (agencies; stations[].station_id with real coordinates; units[].unit_id with home_station and avl_equipped; nature_codes; disposition_codes; priority_levels)
entity_catalog.beats_and_areas: registries/areas.json (area_type patrol_beat: AREA-BEAT-B01..B12 share the beat ids; zip, census_tract, water_district, evacuation_zone for geocoding)
entity_catalog.destinations: registries/facility_registry.json (hospitals and shelters a unit transports to)

fields.name: incident_number
fields.notes: Agency prefix-year-sequence. Prefix by handling agency: CCPD 27, CCFD 19, CCEMS 12, NCSO 31, PAPD 41, mutual-aid fire 52, mutual-aid EMS 53

fields.name: agency
fields.notes: Agency that handled or owns the call type

fields.name: call_received_dttm
fields.notes: Local time (US Central: CDT until 2027-11-07 02:00, then CST), YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. The repeated hour on 2027-11-07 is ambiguous, as in any local-time export

fields.name: call_answered_dttm
fields.notes: Local time the call taker answered

fields.name: dispatch_dttm
fields.notes: Local time the first unit was sent; empty if no unit was sent

fields.name: first_arrival_dttm
fields.notes: Local time the first unit arrived

fields.name: cleared_dttm
fields.notes: Local time the first unit cleared (for transports: when it left the hospital)

fields.name: priority
fields.notes: P1 to P4, see cad_units.json priority_levels

fields.name: nature_code
fields.notes: cad_units.json nature_codes[].code; WATERSAFE (WATER-SAFETY-INQUIRY) is a code the centre created during the response and is not in the registry table

fields.name: address
fields.notes: Block number and street, upper case; the street is the reference-network road the point sits on

fields.name: zip
fields.notes: ZIP of the census tract (areas.json AREA-ZIP-*)

fields.name: beat
fields.notes: CCPD patrol beat id (areas.json AREA-BEAT-*)

fields.name: census_tract
fields.notes: Six-digit tract code (areas.json area_type census_tract 'tract'; census/acs_nueces_tracts.csv TRACT); empty outside Nueces County

fields.name: latitude
fields.notes: WGS84; on land, set back from the street

fields.name: unit_id
fields.notes: First unit sent (cad_units.json units[].unit_id); empty when no unit was sent or an aircraft was tasked through the SAR branch

fields.name: additional_units
fields.notes: Semicolon-separated unit ids

fields.name: disposition_code
fields.notes: cad_units.json disposition_codes[].code

fields.name: narrative
fields.notes: Call taker's summary, upper case; text after ' // ' is the closing remark

fields.name: mutual_aid
fields.notes: true when a mutual-aid or deployed out-of-area unit handled it

fields.name: sar_priority
fields.notes: Y when the call was tagged as a rescue request

fields.name: sar_case_number
fields.notes: SAR case opened from this call (sar/sar_missions.csv case_number)

fields.name: transport_destination
fields.notes: facility_registry.json facility_id of the receiving hospital

fields.name: call_source
fields.notes: 911 or TEXT

fields.name: ali_class_of_service
fields.notes: ALI class: WPH2, WPH1, RESD, BUSN, VOIP

fields.name: ali_carrier
fields.notes: Carrier named in the ALI record (fictional carriers)

fields.name: callback_number
fields.notes: ANI callback number (synthetic); joins to 911/reports/ali_subscriber_records.csv

fields.name: caller_language
fields.notes: EN, ES or OT

fields.name: call_taker_position
fields.notes: Console id; SP-CT and BEE-CT are mutual-aid call takers

joins.to: cad_units.json agencies (CCPD, CCFD, CCEMS, NCSO, PAPD, MA_FIRE, MA_EMS, TF1, TXARNG, NCOEM, CIVBOAT)

baseline: about 310 calls a day before the storm

files.data/911/cad_incidents_YYYY-MM.csv: one row per call for service, by local month of call_received_dttm
files.data/911/reports/cbecc_daily_call_volume: PSAP daily telephone statistics: 911 calls (equals CAD rows), ten-digit line calls, total, answer times, mutual-aid dispatcher hours
files.data/911/reports/cbecc_queue_depth.csv: pending calls and unassigned incidents every 15 minutes through the first three days
carrier subscriber record for every callback number: class of service, carrier, plan, activation date, whether a subscriber is registered

reports/cbecc_daily_call_volume.csv.calls_911: 911 calls answered that day (equals the CAD rows received that local day)
reports/cbecc_daily_call_volume.csv.calls_ten_digit_lines: calls on the centre's ten-digit lines
reports/cbecc_daily_call_volume.csv.incidents_with_unit: CAD incidents that had a unit assigned
reports/cbecc_daily_call_volume.csv.mutual_aid_dispatcher_hours: hours worked by dispatchers on loan from other centres
reports/cbecc_daily_call_volume.csv.positions_staffed: console positions staffed at the daily peak

reports/cbecc_queue_depth.csv.pending_calls_and_unassigned_incidents: calls waiting plus incidents with no unit assigned at that time

reports/cbecc_shift_log.csv.author: role of the person writing (shift supervisor, director)

reports/ali_subscriber_records.csv.callback_number: caller's number as recorded by the 911 system
reports/ali_subscriber_records.csv.class_of_service: ANI/ALI class (wireless, VoIP, residential, business, prepaid wireless)
reports/ali_subscriber_records.csv.subscriber_registered: Y if the carrier holds a registered subscriber name
